questions.question: 1. Which transmission mode is primarily supported by an ideal Coplanar Waveguide (CPW)?

explanations.a: Incorrect. TE mode is not the primary propagation mode in a CPW.
explanations.b: Incorrect. TM mode is not the dominant mode in an ideal CPW.
explanations.c: Correct. An ideal Coplanar Waveguide primarily supports the quasi-TEM mode of propagation.
explanations.d: Incorrect. A CPW does not require a vacuum to support wave propagation.

questions.question: 2. In a CPW, the signal conductor is:

answers.b: Located between two ground conductors on the same plane
answers.c: Placed on the bottom side of the substrate

explanations.a: Incorrect. This does not describe the structure of a coplanar waveguide.
explanations.b: Correct. In a CPW, the center signal conductor is located between two ground conductors on the same plane.
explanations.c: Incorrect. The signal conductor is fabricated on the top surface of the substrate.
explanations.d: Incorrect. The conductor is supported by a dielectric substrate, not suspended in air.

questions.question: 3. A low value of |S11| (e.g., below –10 dB) indicates:

explanations.a: Incorrect. A low |S11| value indicates less reflected power, not poor matching.
explanations.b: Correct. An |S11| value below −10 dB generally indicates good impedance matching.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Insertion loss is represented by S21, not S11.
explanations.d: Incorrect. A low |S11| does not imply that signal transmission is absent.

explanations.a: Incorrect. S11 represents the input reflection coefficient.
explanations.c: Correct. S21 represents the forward transmission from Port 1 to Port 2.
explanations.d: Incorrect. S22 represents the output reflection coefficient.

questions.question: 5. The instrument most commonly used to measure S-parameters is:

explanations.a: Incorrect. An oscilloscope measures voltage versus time, not S-parameters.
explanations.b: Incorrect. A spectrum analyzer measures signal power versus frequency but does not directly measure S-parameters.
explanations.c: Correct. A Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) is the standard instrument used to measure S-parameters.
explanations.d: Incorrect. A multimeter cannot measure microwave S-parameters.
